note: BH-10215. In step record of lane merge-conductor (row lane.merge-conductor.gh_source), prr_serve_state serves a record row whose mergeable_base_seq equals the repo's current base sequence (GET /api/pr-base-seqs, raised by each push webhook to the base) and whose head equals the list head, while the row is at most this many seconds old. This is the backstop for a lost push webhook. A row with no usable sequence keeps the age rule PR_RECORD_SERVE_MAX_AGE_S; a row whose sequence is known and moved misses at any age. Steps off and shadow keep PR_RECORD_SERVE_MAX_AGE_S. Read through lane_knob (libs scope) when the caller has it, else from the environment; a value that is not a non-negative integer is 3600 and one logs/pr-record.log line names it. 0 = off: in step record no row serves by the sequence rule; a row serves only by the age rule PR_RECORD_SERVE_MAX_AGE_S.
